title: Madhya-khanda, part 13 (portion 36)
html:
The section "Before Sannyasa" (end): the Lord speaks of the cruelty of samsara and of how only service to Krishna gives meaning to human birth, and consoles the devotees. The section "Mother Shachi's Grief": Shachi's lament and her pleading; the Lord begins the story of Dhruva — Dhruva's hurt, his mother's counsel, the meeting with Narada, the journey to Madhuvana

Raga vibhasa, the taraja tune; disha: "na hare are haya"

শুন সর্বজন, সংসার দারুণ,
সংশয় করিল মোরে ।
বিষম বিষয়, যেন বিষময়,
গুপতে অন্তর পোড়ে ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

śuna sarbajana, saṃsāra dāruṇa,
saṃśaẏa karila more |
biṣama biṣaẏa, yena biṣamaẏa,
gupate antara poṛe || 135 ||

shuna sarvajana — listen, all; samsara daruna — cruel samsara; samshaya karila more — has put Me in peril; vishama vishaya — dreadful sense-objects; yena vishamaya — as if full of poison; gupate antara pode — secretly burn the heart

135"Listen, all: cruel samsara
has put Me in peril;1
the dreadful objects of the senses, as if full of poison,
secretly burn the heart.

যতেক ইন্দ্রিয়গণ, বলিয়ে আপন,
বাসনা না ছাড়ে কেহো ।
নিত্যই নূতন, করাই ভোজন,
তবু না লেউটে সেহো ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

yateka indriẏagaṇa, baliẏe āpana,
bāsanā nā chāṛe keho |
nityai nūtana, karāi bhojana,
tabu nā leuṭe seho || 136 ||

yateka indriya-gana — all the senses; baliye apana — that one calls one's own; vasana na chhade keho — none gives up its craving; nityai nutana — ever new; karai bhojana — I feed them; tabu na leute seho — still they do not turn back

136All the senses one calls one's own —
not one gives up its cravings;
however much one feeds them with ever new things,
they will not turn back.

লোভ মোহ কাম, কেহো নহে ন্যূন,
মদ অভিমান ক্রোধে ।
চিত চুরি করি', আছয়ে সম্বরি',
তিলেক নাহি প্রবোধে ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

lobha moha kāma, keho nahe nyūna,
mada abhimāna krodhe |
cita curi kari', āchaẏe sambari',
tileka nāhi prabodhe || 137 ||

lobha moha kama — greed, delusion, lust; keho nahe nyuna — none is weaker; mada abhimana krodhe — with pride, conceit and anger; chita churi kari — having stolen the mind; achhaye sambari — lie hidden; tileka nahi prabodhe — are never calmed for a moment

137Greed, delusion, lust — none is weaker,
and with them pride, conceit and anger;
having stolen the mind, they lie hidden in it
and are never calmed for a moment.

বাহিরে বান্ধয়ে, ভ্রমাই মায়ায়ে,
আশ্রয় এ জাতি-কুলে ।
কৃষ্ণ পাশরিয়া, বুলয়ে ভ্রমিয়া,
পাপ-দুর্বাসনা-মূলে ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

bāhire bāndhaẏe, bhramāi māẏāẏe,
āśraẏa e jāti-kule |
kṛṣṇa pāśariẏā, bulaẏe bhramiẏā,
pāpa-durbāsanā-mūle || 138 ||

bahire bandhaye — outwardly binds; bhramai mayaye — maya whirls about; ashraya e jati-kule — a footing in caste and lineage; krishna pashariya — forgetting Krishna; bulaye bhramiya — wanders about; papa-durvasana-mule — rooted in sinful desires

138Outwardly maya binds and whirls [the soul] about,
[giving] it a footing in caste and lineage;
forgetting Krishna, it wanders,
rooted in sinful, evil desires.

জগতে যতেক, দেখ অপরূপ,
কৃষ্ণ-আবরক সভে ।
তবহি সার্থক, মানুষ-জনম,
শ্রীকৃষ্ণ ভজিয়ে যবে ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

jagate yateka, dekha aparūpa,
kṛṣṇa-ābaraka sabhe |
tabahi sārthaka, mānuṣa-janama,
śrīkṛṣṇa bhajiẏe yabe || 139 ||

jagate yateka — everything in the world; dekha aparupa — that you see as wondrous; krishna-avaraka sabhe — all of it hides Krishna; tabahi sarthaka — only then meaningful; manusha-janama — is human birth; shri-krishna bhajiye yabe — when one serves Sri Krishna

139Everything wondrous you see in the world —
all of it hides Krishna;
human birth has meaning only then
when one serves Sri Krishna.

মানুষ-জনম, দুর্লভ জানিয়ে,
কৃষ্ণ ভজিবার তরে ।
হেন দেহ পাঞা, শ্রীকৃষ্ণ ছাড়িয়া,
মরিয়ে মিছা-সংসারে ॥ ১৪০ ॥

mānuṣa-janama, durlabha jāniẏe,
kṛṣṇa bhajibāra tare |
hena deha pāñā, śrīkṛṣṇa chāṛiẏā,
mariẏe michā-saṃsāre || 140 ||

manusha-janama — human birth; durlabha janiye — is known to be rare; krishna bhajibara tare — for serving Krishna; hena deha pana — having obtained such a body; shri-krishna chhadiya — abandoning Sri Krishna; mariye michha-samsare — they die in false samsara

140Human birth, as is known, is rare —
[it is given] for serving Krishna;
yet, having obtained such a body, people abandon Sri Krishna
and die in this false samsara.

শুন সর্বজন, কহিলুঁ মরম,
আশীর্বাদ কর মোরে ।
কৃষ্ণে রতি হউ, এ দুঃখ পালাউ,
এ বর মাগোঁ সভারে ॥ ১৪১ ॥

śuna sarbajana, kahiluṁ marama,
āśīrbāda kara more |
kṛṣṇe rati hau, e duḥkha pālāu,
e bara māgoṁ sabhāre || 141 ||

shuna sarvajana — listen, all; kahilun marama — I have told what is in My heart; ashirvada kara more — bless Me; krishne rati hau — let there be love for Krishna; e duhkha palau — let this sorrow flee; e bara magon sabhare — this boon I ask of all

141Listen, all — I have told you what is in My heart:
bless Me,
that I may have love for Krishna and this sorrow may flee —
this boon I ask of everyone.

কৃষ্ণের চরিত, গাঙ অবিরত,
বদনে লাগয়ে সাধে ।
শ্রীমুখ-কমলে, নয়ান-যুগলে,
হিয়া বান্ধোঁ শ্রীপদে ॥ ১৪২ ॥

kṛṣṇera carita, gāṅa abirata,
badane lāgaẏe sādhe |
śrīmukha-kamale, naẏāna-yugale,
hiẏā bāndhoṁ śrīpade || 142 ||

krishnera charita — Krishna's deeds; gaun avirata — to sing unceasingly; badane lagaye sadhe — the lips long; shri-mukha-kamale — on His lotus face; nayana-yugale — the two eyes; hiya bandhon shri-pade — I shall bind My heart to His holy feet

142To sing Krishna's deeds unceasingly —
this is what My lips long for;
My eyes — on His lotus face,
My heart I shall bind to His holy feet.

কি কহিব হিয়া, কৃষ্ণ না দেখিয়া,
মরমে বিরহ-জ্বালা ।
সংসার-সাগরে, পড়িয়া পাথারে,
চিত বেয়াকুল ভেলা ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

ki kahiba hiẏā, kṛṣṇa nā dekhiẏā,
marame biraha-jbālā |
saṃsāra-sāgare, paṛiẏā pāthāre,
cita beẏākula bhelā || 143 ||

ki kahiba hiya — what shall I say of the heart; krishna na dekhiya — not seeing Krishna; marame viraha-jvala — the fire of separation in its depths; samsara-sagare — into the ocean of samsara; padiya pathare — fallen into the deep; chita veyakula bhela — the mind is distraught

143What shall I say of My heart? Not seeing Krishna,
the fire of separation burns in its depths;
fallen into the ocean of samsara, into the deep,
My mind is distraught.

সেই পিতা মাতা, সেই সে দেবতা,
সেই গুরু বন্ধুজনে ।
সেই সে শুনায়ে, কৃষ্ণকথা কহে,
ভজায়ে কৃষ্ণচরণে ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

sei pitā mātā, sei se debatā,
sei guru bandhujane |
sei se śunāẏe, kṛṣṇakathā kahe,
bhajāẏe kṛṣṇacaraṇe || 144 ||

sei pita mata — he is father and mother; sei se devata — he is a deity; sei guru bandhu-jane — he is guru and friend; sei se shunaye — who lets one hear; krishna-katha kahe — tells of Krishna; bhajaye krishna-charane — brings one to serve Krishna's feet

144He alone is father and mother, he alone is a deity,
he alone a guru and friend,
who lets one hear and tells of Krishna,
who brings one to serve Krishna's feet.

তোমরা বান্ধব, পরম বৈষ্ণব,
দয়া না ছাড়িহ চিতে ।
সন্ন্যাস করিব, প্রেম বিথারিব,
সব তো-সভার হিতে ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

tomarā bāndhaba, parama baiṣṇaba,
daẏā nā chāṛiha cite |
sannyāsa kariba, prema bithāriba,
saba to-sabhāra hite || 145 ||

tomara bandhava — you are friends; parama vaishnava — supreme Vaishnavas; daya na chhadiha chite — do not give up mercy in your hearts; sannyasa kariba — I shall take sannyasa; prema vithariba — I shall spread prema; saba to-sabhara hite — all for your good

145You are My friends, supreme Vaishnavas:
do not withdraw your mercy from Me in your hearts.
I shall take sannyasa and spread prema —
all for your own good."

এতেক উত্তর, কহি' বিশ্বম্ভর,
ভূমে গড়াগড়ি বুলে ।
ধূলায় ধূসর, গৌর-কলেবর,
লোটায়ে মুকুল-চুলি ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

eteka uttara, kahi' biśbambhara,
bhūme gaṛāgaṛi bule |
dhūlāẏa dhūsara, gaura-kalebara,
loṭāẏe mukula-culi || 146 ||

eteka uttara kahi — having said this; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; bhume gadagadi bule — rolls on the ground; dhulaya dhusara — grey with dust; gaura-kalebara — the golden body; lotaye mukula-chuli — the loosened hair sweeps the ground

146Having said this, Vishvambhara
rolls on the ground;
Gaura's golden body is grey with dust,
His loosened hair sweeps the ground.

হরি হরি বোল, ডাকে উতরোল,
সঘন নিশ্বাস নাসা ।
অঙ্গের পুলক, আপাদ-মস্তক,
গদগদ আধ ভাষা ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

hari hari bola, ḍāke utarola,
saghana niśbāsa nāsā |
aṅgera pulaka, āpāda-mastaka,
gadagada ādha bhāṣā || 147 ||

hari hari bola — "Haribol!"; dake utarola — calls aloud; saghana nishvasa nasa — breathing deep and fast; angera pulaka — the body's thrill; apada-mastaka — from feet to head; gadgada adha bhasha — faltering, half-said words

147"Haribol!" He calls aloud,
breathing deep and fast;
His body thrills from feet to head,
His speech falters, words left half-said.

ক্ষণেক রোদন, ক্ষণেক বেদন,
ক্ষণে চমকিত চাহে ।
ক্ষণে হাপ-ঝাঁপ, কলেবর কাঁপ,
ক্ষণে উঠে কৃষ্ণ-বিরহে ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

kṣaṇeka rodana, kṣaṇeka bedana,
kṣaṇe camakita cāhe |
kṣaṇe hāpa-jhāṁpa, kalebara kāṁpa,
kṣaṇe uṭhe kṛṣṇa-birahe || 148 ||

kshaneka rodana — now weeping; kshaneka vedana — now anguish; kshane chamakita chahe — now He starts and looks about; kshane hapa-jhanpa — now gasping and tossing; kalebara kanpa — the body trembling; kshane uthe krishna-virahe — now He springs up in separation from Krishna

148Now He weeps, now He is in anguish,
now He starts and looks about,
now He gasps and tosses, His whole body trembling,
now He springs up in separation from Krishna.

ক্ষণে উতরোলি, বৃন্দাবন বলি',
ক্ষণে রাধা বলি' ডাকে ।
মালসাট মারি', বোলে হরি হরি,
ক্ষণে হাত মারে বুকে ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

kṣaṇe utaroli, bṛndābana bali',
kṣaṇe rādhā bali' ḍāke |
mālasāṭa māri', bole hari hari,
kṣaṇe hāta māre buke || 149 ||

kshane utaroli — now crying aloud; vrindavana bali — "Vrindavana!"; kshane radha bali dake — now calls "Radha!"; malasata mari — slapping His arms; bole hari hari — says "Hari, Hari"; kshane hata mare buke — now strikes His breast with His hand

149Now He cries aloud: "Vrindavana!"
now He calls: "Radha!"
He slaps His arms like a wrestler, says "Hari, Hari",
now He strikes His breast with His hand.

দেখি' সর্বজন, গুণে মনে মন,
অন্তরে কাতর হঞা ।
কি বলিব আর, দুখের পাথারে,
পড়িল যে-হেন গিয়া ॥ ১৫০ ॥

dekhi' sarbajana, guṇe mane mana,
antare kātara hañā |
ki baliba āra, dukhera pāthāre,
paṛila ye-hena giẏā || 150 ||

dekhi sarvajana — seeing [this], all; gune mane mana — ponder within; antare katara haña — anguished at heart; ki baliba ara — what more to say; dukhera pathare — into an ocean of grief; padila ye-hena giya — as if they had fallen

150Seeing this, all ponder within themselves,
anguished at heart:
what more is there to say? — it was as if they had fallen
into an ocean of grief.

কহয়ে মুরারি, শুন গৌরহরি,
স্বতন্ত্র তুমি সর্বথা ।
লোক বুঝাবারে, করুণা-প্রচারে,
ভাবহ বিরহ-ব্যথা ॥ ১৫১ ॥

kahaẏe murāri, śuna gaurahari,
sbatantra tumi sarbathā |
loka bujhābāre, karuṇā-pracāre,
bhābaha biraha-byathā || 151 ||

kahaye murari — Murari says; shuna gaurahari — listen, Gaurahari; svatantra tumi sarvatha — You are independent in everything; loka bujhabare — to teach people; karuna-prachare — to reveal mercy; bhavaha viraha-vyatha — You take on the bhava of the pain of separation

151Murari says: "Listen, Gaurahari:
You are independent in everything;
to teach people, to reveal mercy,
You take on the bhava of the pain of separation.2

তুমি যে করিবে, নিজ-মন-সুখে,
তাহে কি বলিব আনে ।
তুমি সব জান, যে কর বিধান,
কি হয়ে জীব-পরাণে ॥ ১৫২ ॥

tumi ye karibe, nija-mana-sukhe,
tāhe ki baliba āne |
tumi saba jāna, ye kara bidhāna,
ki haẏe jība-parāṇe || 152 ||

tumi ye karibe — whatever You do; nija-mana-sukhe — by Your own heart's will; tahe ki baliba ane — what can others say about it; tumi saba jana — You know everything; ye kara vidhana — whatever You ordain; ki haye jiva-parane — what can poor souls do

152Whatever You do by the will of Your own heart —
what can others say about it?
You know everything; whatever You ordain —
what can poor souls do about it?

মোরা সব জীব, না জানি কি হব,
কীট-পিপীলিকা হেন ।
তুমি দয়াসিন্ধু, সব-লোক-বন্ধু,
বুঝিয়া করহ যেন ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

morā saba jība, nā jāni ki haba,
kīṭa-pipīlikā hena |
tumi daẏāsindhu, saba-loka-bandhu,
bujhiẏā karaha yena || 153 ||

mora saba jiva — we are all jivas; na jani ki haba — we do not know what will be; kita-pipilika hena — like worms and ants; tumi daya-sindhu — You are the ocean of mercy; saba-loka-bandhu — the friend of all people; bujhiya karaha yena — consider and act as is fitting

153We are all jivas, we do not know what will become of us,
we are like worms and ants;
You are the ocean of mercy, the friend of all people:
consider and do what is fitting."

এ বোল শুনিঞা, সে পহুঁ হাসিয়া,
সভারে করিলা কোলে ।
প্রেম প্রকাশিয়া, সভা সম্বোধিয়া,
প্রবোধ-বচনে বোলে ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

e bola śuniñā, se pahuṁ hāsiẏā,
sabhāre karilā kole |
prema prakāśiẏā, sabhā sambodhiẏā,
prabodha-bacane bole || 154 ||

e bola shuniña — hearing this; se panhu hasiya — the Lord, smiling; sabhare karila kole — embraced all; prema prakashiya — revealing prema; sabha sambodhiya — addressing all; prabodha-vachane bole — speaks words of consolation

154Hearing this, the Lord smiled
and embraced them all;
revealing prema, addressing them all,
He speaks words of consolation:

শুন সর্বজন, কহিয়ে বচন,
সন্দেহ না কর কেহো ।
যথা-তথা যাই, তো-সভার ঠাঞি
আছিয়ে, জানিহ এহো ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

śuna sarbajana, kahiẏe bacana,
sandeha nā kara keho |
yathā-tathā yāi, to-sabhāra ṭhāñi
āchiẏe, jāniha eho || 155 ||

shuna sarvajana — listen, all; kahiye vachana — to what I say; sandeha na kara keho — let no one doubt; yatha-tatha yai — wherever I go; to-sabhara thani achhiye — I remain with you; janiha eho — know this

155"Listen, all, to what I say,
let no one doubt:
wherever I may go, I remain with you —
know this."3

তবে বিশ্বম্ভর, গেলা নিজ ঘর,
সভারে বিদায় দিয়া ।
সন্ন্যাস হৃদয়ে, সকল করয়ে,
জননী না জানে ইহা ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

tabe biśbambhara, gelā nija ghara,
sabhāre bidāẏa diẏā |
sannyāsa hṛdaẏe, sakala karaẏe,
jananī nā jāne ihā || 156 ||

tabe vishvambhara — then Vishvambhara; gela nija ghara — went home; sabhare vidaya diya — taking leave of all; sannyasa hridaye — with sannyasa in His heart; sakala karaye — makes all [preparations]; janani na jane iha — His mother does not know of it

156Then Vishvambhara, taking leave of all,
went home;
with sannyasa in His heart He makes every preparation,
but His mother does not know of it.

শচীর অন্তরে, ধকধক করে,
সোয়াথ না পায় চিতে ।
লোচন বোলে হেন, প্রেমার সাগর,
কেমনে চাহে ছাড়িতে ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

śacīra antare, dhakadhaka kare,
soẏātha nā pāẏa cite |
locana bole hena, premāra sāgara,
kemane cāhe chāṛite || 157 ||

shachira antare — in Shachi's heart; dhakadhaka kare — it beats anxiously; soyatha na paya chite — she finds no peace; lochana bole — Lochana says; hena premara sagara — such an ocean of love; kemane chahe chhadite — how can [He] wish to leave

157Shachi's heart beats anxiously,
she finds no peace.
Lochana says: how can He wish
to leave such an ocean of love?

Mother Shachi's Grief

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. Hearing from people that Sriman Mahaprabhu would soon take sannyasa, mother Shachi, beside herself with grief, weeping, earnestly begged the Lord not to take sannyasa in His youth but to keep the dharma of a householder. Then Sriman Mahaprabhu, telling [her the story] of Dhruva and of the instruction his mother gave him — to serve Krishna — [revealed to her] that apart from Krishna the living being has no other refuge; that therefore whoever teaches one to serve Krishna is one's true father, mother, brother and friend; that those intoxicated by the conceit of "I" and "mine" are the greatest fools; and that service to Krishna is the meaning of human life. Having declared this, He instructed her to give up attachment to her son such as souls in the grip of maya have, and vowed that, not like other sons [who bring their mothers] silver, gold and other perishable things, He would bring her the eternal, highest good — prema. Then Gaurahari showed Himself to her in the form of Sri Krishna and dispelled mother Shachi's grief.4

Raga ahiri; disha: "Ah, my son, do not leave me — but for you I have no one in the three worlds!"

এই মনে অনুমানে জানাজানি কথা ।
সন্ন্যাস করিবে পুত্র শুনে শচীমাতা ॥ ১ ॥

ei mane anumāne jānājāni kathā |
sannyāsa karibe putra śune śacīmātā || 1 ||

ei mane anumane — thus by guesses; janajani katha — by rumours; sannyasa karibe putra — that her son will take sannyasa; shune shachi-mata — mother Shachi hears

1Thus, by guesses and rumours,
mother Shachi heard that her son would take sannyasa.

আকাশ ভাঙ্গিয়া পড়ে মস্তক-উপর ।
অচেতন হৈলা শচী মূর্চ্ছিত-অন্তর ॥ ২ ॥

ākāśa bhāṅgiẏā paṛe mastaka-upara |
acetana hailā śacī mūrcchita-antara || 2 ||

akasha bhangiya pade — the sky breaks and falls; mastaka-upara — on her head; achetana haila shachi — Shachi lost consciousness; murchchhita-antara — her heart swooned

2It was as if the sky had fallen on her head:
Shachi lost consciousness, her heart swooned.

উন্মতী পাগলী শচী বেড়ায় চৌদিগে ।
যারে দেখে তারে পুছে সব নবদ্বীপে ॥ ৩ ॥

unmatī pāgalī śacī beṛāẏa caudige |
yāre dekhe tāre puche saba nabadbīpe || 3 ||

unmati pagali shachi — like a madwoman, Shachi; bedaya chaudige — rushes about on all sides; yare dekhe tare puchhe — whomever she sees she asks; saba navadvipe — all over Navadvipa

3Like a madwoman Shachi rushes about on every side;
whomever she sees she questions — all over Navadvipa.

নিশ্চয় জানিল—পুত্র করিব সন্ন্যাস ।
বিশ্বম্ভরের কাছে গিয়া ছাড়য়ে নিশ্বাস ॥ ৪ ॥

niścaẏa jānila—putra kariba sannyāsa |
biśbambharera kāche giẏā chāṛaẏe niśbāsa || 4 ||

nishchaya janila — she knew for certain; putra kariba sannyasa — her son will take sannyasa; vishvambharera kachhe giya — going to Vishvambhara; chhadaye nishvasa — heaves sighs

4Knowing for certain that her son would take sannyasa,
she came to Vishvambhara and heaves deep sighs:

তুমি মাত্র পুত্র মোর, দেহে এক আঁখি ।
তোরে না দেখিলে অন্ধকারময় দেখি ॥ ৫ ॥

tumi mātra putra mora, dehe eka āṁkhi |
tore nā dekhile andhakāramaẏa dekhi || 5 ||

tumi matra putra mora — you are my only son; dehe eka ankhi — the one eye in my body; tore na dekhile — when I do not see you; andhakara-maya dekhi — I see all as darkness

5"You are my only son, the one eye in my body:
when I do not see you, I see everything in darkness.

লোকমুখে শুনি বাপু করিবে সন্ন্যাস ।
মোর মুণ্ডে ভাঙ্গি যেন পড়িল আকাশ ॥ ৬ ॥

lokamukhe śuni bāpu karibe sannyāsa |
mora muṇḍe bhāṅgi yena paṛila ākāśa || 6 ||

loka-mukhe shuni — I hear from people; bapu karibe sannyasa — my child, you will take sannyasa; mora munde bhangi — breaking over my head; yena padila akasha — as if the sky fell

6I hear from people, my child, that you will take sannyasa —
it is as if the sky had broken over my head.

একাকিনী অনাথিনী, আর কেহো নাহি ।
সকল পাসরি' এক তোর মুখ চাহি ॥ ৭ ॥

ekākinī anāthinī, āra keho nāhi |
sakala pāsari' eka tora mukha cāhi || 7 ||

ekakini anathini — alone, unprotected; ara keho nahi — there is no one else; sakala pasari — forgetting everything; eka tora mukha chahi — I look only at your face

7I am alone, unprotected — I have no one else;
forgetting all else, I look only at your face.

নয়নের তারা মোর কুলের প্রদীপ ।
তোমা পুত্রে ভাগ্যবতী বোলে নবদ্বীপ ॥ ৮ ॥

naẏanera tārā mora kulera pradīpa |
tomā putre bhāgyabatī bole nabadbīpa || 8 ||

nayanera tara mora — the pupil of my eyes; kulera pradipa — the lamp of the family; toma putre — for a son like you; bhagyavati bole navadvipa — Navadvipa calls [me] fortunate

8You are the pupil of my eyes, the lamp of our family;
for having such a son as you Navadvipa calls me fortunate.

না ঘুচাহ আরে পুত্র মোর অহঙ্কার ।
তুমি না থাকিলে সব হব ছারখার ॥ ৯ ॥

nā ghucāha āre putra mora ahaṅkāra |
tumi nā thākile saba haba chārakhāra || 9 ||

na ghuchaha are putra — do not destroy, my son; mora ahankara — my pride; tumi na thakile — if you are not here; saba haba chharakhara — everything will go to ruin

9Do not destroy my pride, my son:
if you are gone, everything will go to ruin.

ভাগ্য মানে যে না জন দেখে মোর মুখ ।
এখন আমারে দেখি' হইব বিমুখ ॥ ১০ ॥

bhāgya māne ye nā jana dekhe mora mukha |
ekhana āmāre dekhi' haiba bimukha || 10 ||

bhagya mane — counted it good fortune; ye na jana dekhe mora mukha — the people who saw my face; ekhana amare dekhi — now, seeing me; haiba vimukha — will turn away

10People counted it good fortune to see my face —
now, seeing me, they will turn away.

তুমি হেন পুত্র মোর এ সংসারে ধন্য ।
তোমা না দেখিলে মোর সকলি অরণ্য ॥ ১১ ॥

tumi hena putra mora e saṃsāre dhanya |
tomā nā dekhile mora sakali araṇya || 11 ||

tumi hena putra mora — having such a son as you; e samsare dhanya — [I am] blessed in this world; toma na dekhile — not seeing you; mora sakali aranya — all is wilderness to me

11Having such a son as you, I am blessed in this world —
but not seeing you, I see nothing but wilderness around me.

দুখ দিয়া অভাগীরে ছাড়ি' যাবে তুমি ।
গঙ্গায় প্রবেশ করি' মরি' যাব আমি ॥ ১২ ॥

dukha diẏā abhāgīre chāṛi' yābe tumi |
gaṅgāẏa prabeśa kari' mari' yāba āmi || 12 ||

dukha diya abhagire — giving grief to the unfortunate one; chhadi yabe tumi — you will go away; gangaya pravesha kari — entering the Ganga; mari yaba ami — I shall die

12Giving grief to this unfortunate woman, you will go away —
and I shall enter the Ganga and die.

এহেন কোমল-পায়ে কেমনে হাঁটিবে ।
ক্ষুধায় তৃষ্ণায় অন্ন কাহারে মাগিবে ॥ ১৩ ॥

ehena komala-pāẏe kemane hāṁṭibe |
kṣudhāẏa tṛṣṇāẏa anna kāhāre māgibe || 13 ||

ehena komala-paye — on such tender feet; kemane hantibe — how will you walk; kshudhaya trishnaya — in hunger and thirst; anna kahare magibe — from whom will you beg food

13How will you walk on such tender feet?
Hungry and thirsty — from whom will you beg food?

ননীর পুতলী তনু রৌদ্রেতে মিলায় ।
কেমনে সহিব ইহা এ দুখিনী মায় ॥ ১৪ ॥

nanīra putalī tanu raudrete milāẏa |
kemane sahiba ihā e dukhinī māẏa || 14 ||

nanira putali tanu — the body a doll of butter; raudrete milaya — melts in the sun; kemane sahiba iha — how will she bear this; e dukhini maya — this wretched mother

14Your body is like a doll of butter: it will melt in the sun;
how will this wretched mother bear it?

হাপুতির পুত মোর সোণার নিমাই ।
আমারে ছাড়িয়া তুমি যাবে কোন ঠাঞি ॥ ১৫ ॥

hāputira puta mora soṇāra nimāi |
āmāre chāṛiẏā tumi yābe kona ṭhāñi || 15 ||

haputira puta mora — son of a mother bereft of children; sonara nimai — my golden Nimai; amare chhadiya tumi — leaving me, you; yabe kona thani — where will you go

15Son of a mother bereft of her children, my golden Nimai!
Leaving me, where will you go?5

বিষ খাঞা মরি বাপ তোর বিদ্যমানে ।
তোমার সন্ন্যাস যেন না শুনিয়ে কাণে ॥ ১৬ ॥

biṣa khāñā mari bāpa tora bidyamāne |
tomāra sannyāsa yena nā śuniẏe kāṇe || 16 ||

visha khana mari — I shall take poison and die; bapa tora vidyamane — my child, before your eyes; tomara sannyasa — of your sannyasa; yena na shuniye kane — so as not to hear with my ears

16I shall take poison and die before your eyes,
so as not to hear with my ears of your sannyasa.

আমারে মারিয়া বাপু যাইবে বিদেশে ।
আগুনি জ্বালিয়া তাথে করিব প্রবেশে ॥ ১৭ ॥

āmāre māriẏā bāpu yāibe bideśe |
āguni jbāliẏā tāthe kariba prabeśe || 17 ||

amare mariya — having killed me; bapu yaibe videshe — my child, you will go abroad; aguni jvaliya — lighting a fire; tathe kariba praveshe — I shall enter it

17Having killed me, my child, you will go to foreign lands —
and I shall light a fire and enter it.

সর্বজীবে দয়া তোর, মোরে অকরুণ ।
না জানি কি লাগি মোরে বিধাতা দারুণ ॥ ১৮ ॥

sarbajībe daẏā tora, more akaruṇa |
nā jāni ki lāgi more bidhātā dāruṇa || 18 ||

sarva-jive daya tora — you have mercy for all beings; more akaruna — for me none; na jani ki lagi — I know not why; more vidhata daruna — the Creator is cruel to me

18To all beings you are merciful — but to me merciless;
I do not know why the Creator is so cruel to me.

রূপে গুণে শীলে পুত্র ত্রিজগত-ধন্য ।
কামিনী-মোহন বেশ কেশের লাবণ্য ॥ ১৯ ॥

rūpe guṇe śīle putra trijagata-dhanya |
kāminī-mohana beśa keśera lābaṇya || 19 ||

rupe gune shile — in beauty, virtues and nature; putra trijagata-dhanya — my son, you are blessed in the three worlds; kamini-mohana besha — a dress that enchants women; keshera lavanya — the loveliness of your hair

19In beauty, virtues and nature, my son, you are blessed in the three worlds;
your dress enchants women, your hair is lovely.

অংস-বিলম্বিত কেশে মালতী বান্ধিয়া ।
জুড়ায় পরাণ মোর সে বেশ দেখিয়া ॥ ২০ ॥

aṃsa-bilambita keśe mālatī bāndhiẏā |
juṛāẏa parāṇa mora se beśa dekhiẏā || 20 ||

amsa-vilambita keshe — in the hair falling to the shoulders; malati bandhiya — tying malati; judaya parana mora — my heart is eased; se besha dekhiya — seeing that attire

20When you weave malati into your hair that falls to your shoulders,
my heart is eased at the sight of that attire.

বয়স্য-বেষ্টিত তুমি চলি' যাহ পথে ।
দেখিয়া জুড়ায় হিয়া, পুঁথি বামহাথে ॥ ২১ ॥

baẏasya-beṣṭita tumi cali' yāha pathe |
dekhiẏā juṛāẏa hiẏā, puṁthi bāmahāthe || 21 ||

vayasya-veshtita tumi — you, surrounded by friends; chali yaha pathe — walk along the road; dekhiya judaya hiya — seeing, the heart is glad; punthi vama-hathe — a book in your left hand

21You walk along the road surrounded by friends,
a book in your left hand — and seeing you, my heart is glad.

কেমনে ছাড়িবা বাপু নিজ-সঙ্গিগণ ।
না করিবে তা-সভা-সহিত সংকীর্তন ॥ ২২ ॥

kemane chāṛibā bāpu nija-saṅgigaṇa |
nā karibe tā-sabhā-sahita saṃkīrtana || 22 ||

kemane chhadiba bapu — how will you leave, my child; nija-sangi-gana — your companions; na karibe — you will not perform; ta-sabha-sahita sankirtana — sankirtana with them

22How will you leave your companions, my child?
Will you no longer perform sankirtana with them?

সে-হেন সুন্দর বেশে না নাচিবে আর ।
যাহা দেখি' মোহ পায় সকল সংসার ॥ ২৩ ॥

se-hena sundara beśe nā nācibe āra |
yāhā dekhi' moha pāẏa sakala saṃsāra || 23 ||

se-hena sundara beshe — in such lovely attire; na nachibe ara — you will dance no more; yaha dekhi — seeing which; moha paya sakala samsara — the whole world is enchanted

23Will you no longer dance in such lovely attire,
at the sight of which the whole world is enchanted?

কেমনে বা জীবে তোর নিজ-প্রিয়জন ।
সভারে মারিয়া তোর সন্ন্যাস-করণ ॥ ২৪ ॥

kemane bā jībe tora nija-priẏajana |
sabhāre māriẏā tora sannyāsa-karaṇa || 24 ||

kemane va jive — how will they live; tora nija-priya-jana — your dear ones; sabhare mariya — killing all; tora sannyasa-karana — is your taking sannyasa

24How will your dear ones live?
Your sannyasa will kill them all.

আগে ত মরিব আমি, তবে বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া ।
মরিবে ভকত সব বুক বিদরিয়া ॥ ২৫ ॥

āge ta mariba āmi, tabe biṣṇupriẏā |
maribe bhakata saba buka bidariẏā || 25 ||

age ta mariba ami — first I shall die; tabe vishnupriya — then Vishnupriya; maribe bhakata saba — all the devotees will die; buka vidariya — their hearts bursting

25First I shall die, then Vishnupriya;
the devotees will die, their hearts bursting:

মুরারি মুকুন্দ দত্ত আর শ্রীনিবাস ।
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-আদি আর হরিদাস ॥ ২৬ ॥

murāri mukunda datta āra śrīnibāsa |
adbaita-ācārya-ādi āra haridāsa || 26 ||

murari mukunda datta — Murari, Mukunda Datta; ara shrinivasa — and Srinivasa; advaita-acharya-adi — Advaita Acharya and others; ara haridasa — and Haridasa

26Murari, Mukunda Datta and Srinivasa,
Advaita Acharya and others, and Haridasa,

গদাধর নরহরি শ্রীরঘুনন্দন ।
বাসুদেব ঘোষ বক্রেশ্বর শ্রীরাম ॥ ২৭ ॥

gadādhara narahari śrīraghunandana |
bāsudeba ghoṣa bakreśbara śrīrāma || 27 ||

gadadhara narahari — Gadadhara, Narahari; shri-raghunandana — Sri Raghunandana; vasudeva ghosha — Vasudeva Ghosha; vakreshvara shrirama — Vakreshvara, Sri Rama

27Gadadhara, Narahari, Sri Raghunandana,
Vasudeva Ghosha, Vakreshvara, Sri Rama —

মরিব সকল লোক না দেখিয়া তোমা ।
এ সব দেখিয়া বাপু চিত্তে দেহ ক্ষমা ॥ ২৮ ॥

mariba sakala loka nā dekhiẏā tomā |
e saba dekhiẏā bāpu citte deha kṣamā || 28 ||

mariba sakala loka — all will die; na dekhiya toma — not seeing you; e saba dekhiya — seeing all this; bapu chitte deha kshama — my child, soften your heart

28all will die, not seeing you;
seeing all this, my child, soften your heart.

পিতৃহীন পুত্র তুমি, দিল দুই বিভা ।
অপত্য সন্ততি কিছু না দেখিল ইহা ॥ ২৯ ॥

pitṛhīna putra tumi, dila dui bibhā |
apatya santati kichu nā dekhila ihā || 29 ||

pitrihina putra tumi — you are a son without a father; dila dui vibha — [I] married you twice; apatya santati kichhu — any offspring; na dekhila iha — I have not seen from this

29You are a son without a father; I married you twice,
but I have seen no offspring from it.

তরুণ-বয়সে নহে সন্ন্যাসের ধর্ম ।
গৃহস্থ-আশ্রমে থাকি' সাধ সব কর্ম ॥ ৩০ ॥

taruṇa-baẏase nahe sannyāsera dharma |
gṛhastha-āśrame thāki' sādha saba karma || 30 ||

taruna-bayase — in youth; nahe sannyasera dharma — sannyasa is not dharma; grihastha-ashrame thaki — living in the householder's ashrama; sadha saba karma — fulfil all duties

30Sannyasa in youth is not dharma;
live in the householder's ashrama and fulfil all your duties.

কাম ক্রোধ লোভ মোহ যৌবনে প্রবল ।
সন্ন্যাস কেমনে তোর হইবে সফল ॥ ৩১ ॥

kāma krodha lobha moha yaubane prabala |
sannyāsa kemane tora haibe saphala || 31 ||

kama krodha lobha moha — lust, anger, greed, delusion; yauvane prabala — are strong in youth; sannyasa kemane tora — how will your sannyasa; haibe saphala — succeed

31In youth lust, anger, greed and delusion are strong —
how will your sannyasa succeed?

মনের নিবৃত্তি কলিকালে নাহি হয় ।
মনের চাঞ্চল্যে সন্ন্যাসের ধর্মক্ষয় ॥ ৩২ ॥

manera nibṛtti kalikāle nāhi haẏa |
manera cāñcalye sannyāsera dharmakṣaẏa || 32 ||

manera nivritti — the curbing of the mind; kali-kale nahi haya — is not possible in the Kali age; manera chanchalye — through the mind's unsteadiness; sannyasera dharma-kshaya — the dharma of sannyasa perishes

32In the Kali age the mind cannot be curbed;
through the mind's unsteadiness the dharma of sannyasa perishes.

গৃহিজন মনঃপাপে নাহি হয় বন্ধ ।
সন্ন্যাসীর ধর্ম যায় মনোজ-অশুদ্ধ ॥ ৩৩ ॥

gṛhijana manaḥpāpe nāhi haẏa bandha |
sannyāsīra dharma yāẏa manoja-aśuddha || 33 ||

grihi-jana — a householder; manah-pape nahi haya bandha — is not bound by sins of the mind; sannyasira dharma yaya — a sannyasi's dharma is lost; manoja-ashuddha — if defiled by desire

33A householder is not bound by sins of the mind,
but a sannyasi's dharma is lost if his mind is defiled by desire."6

এতেক বচন যদি শচীদেবী বৈল ।
শুনিঞা প্রবোধ-বাণী মায়েরে কহিল ॥ ৩৪ ॥

eteka bacana yadi śacīdebī baila |
śuniñā prabodha-bāṇī māẏere kahila || 34 ||

eteka vachana — such words; yadi shachi-devi baila — when Shachi-devi had spoken; shuniña — having heard; prabodha-vani mayere kahila — He spoke words of consolation to His mother

34When Shachi-devi had spoken these words,
[the Lord], having heard them, spoke words of consolation to His mother:

নরহরি-পাদপদ্ম শিরের ভূষণ ।
গৌরাঙ্গ-চরিত কহে এ দাস লোচন ॥ ৩৪+১ ॥

narahari-pādapadma śirera bhūṣaṇa |
gaurāṅga-carita kahe e dāsa locana || 34+1 ||

narahari-pada-padma — Narahari's lotus feet; shirera bhushana — the ornament of the head; gauranga-charita kahe — tells of Gauranga's deeds; e dasa lochana — this servant Lochana

34+1Narahari's lotus feet are the ornament of my head;
of Gauranga's deeds this servant Lochana tells7.

Raga — any; refrain: "The nectar words of the moon-like lips…"8

ধ্রুবেরে বৈষ্ণব কৈল ধ্রুবের জননী ।
কহিয়ে সে রস শুন অপূর্ব কাহিনী ॥ ৩৫ ॥

dhrubere baiṣṇaba kaila dhrubera jananī |
kahiẏe se rasa śuna apūrba kāhinī || 35 ||

dhruvere vaishnava kaila — made Dhruva a Vaishnava; dhruvera janani — Dhruva's mother; kahiye se rasa — I tell that rasa; shuna apurva kahini — hear a wondrous tale

35"Dhruva's mother made Dhruva a Vaishnava —
I shall tell that rasa: hear a wondrous tale.9

Thus [in the Padyavali]:

ব্যাধস্যাচরণং ধ্রুবস্য চ বয়ো বিদ্যা গজেন্দ্রস্য কা
কুব্জায়াঃ কিমু নাম রূপমধিকং কিং তৎ সুদাম্নো ধনম্ ।
বংশঃ কো বিদুরস্য যাদবপতেরুগ্রস্য কিং পৌরুষং
ভক্ত্যা তুষ্যতি কেবলং ন চ গুণৈর্ভক্তিপ্রিয়ো মাধবঃ ॥ ৩৬ ॥

byādhasyācaraṇaṃ dhrubasya ca baẏo bidyā gajendrasya kā
kubjāẏāḥ kimu nāma rūpamadhikaṃ kiṃ tat sudāmno dhanam |
baṃśaḥ ko bidurasya yādabapaterugrasya kiṃ pauruṣaṃ
bhaktyā tuṣyati kebalaṃ na ca guṇairbhaktipriẏo mādhabaḥ || 36 ||

vyadhasya acharanam — the conduct of the hunter; dhruvasya cha vayah — and the age of Dhruva; vidya gajendrasya ka — what the learning of Gajendra; kubjayah kimu nama rupam adhikam — what the name and beauty of Kubja; kim tat sudamnah dhanam — what the wealth of Sudama; vamshah kah vidurasya — what the lineage of Vidura; yadava-pateh ugrasya kim paurusham — what the prowess of Ugrasena, lord of the Yadavas; bhaktya tushyati kevalam — is pleased by devotion alone; na cha gunaih — not by qualities; bhakti-priyah madhavah — Madhava, who loves devotion

36What was the conduct of the hunter, what the age of Dhruva, what the learning of Gajendra, what the name and beauty of Kubja, what the wealth of Sudama, what the lineage of Vidura, what the prowess of Ugrasena, lord of the Yadavas? Madhava, who loves devotion, is pleased by devotion alone, not by qualities.10

শুন মাতা ধ্রুব-কথা এক-মন-চিতে ।
অতি উচ্চ পদ ধ্রুব পাইল যেনমতে ॥ ৩৭ ॥

śuna mātā dhruba-kathā eka-mana-cite |
ati ucca pada dhruba pāila yenamate || 37 ||

shuna mata — listen, mother; dhruva-katha — to the story of Dhruva; eka-mana-chite — attentively; ati uchcha pada — the very highest position; dhruva paila yenamate — how Dhruva attained

37Listen, mother, attentively to the story of Dhruva —
how Dhruva attained the very highest position.

ব্রহ্মার মানসপুত্র স্বায়ম্ভুব মনু ।
মহাতেজ পরাক্রম যেন ব্রহ্মতনু ॥ ৩৮ ॥

brahmāra mānasaputra sbāẏambhuba manu |
mahāteja parākrama yena brahmatanu || 38 ||

brahmara manasa-putra — the mind-born son of Brahma; svayambhuva manu — Svayambhuva Manu; maha-teja parakrama — of great might and valour; yena brahma-tanu — like Brahma's own body

38The mind-born son of Brahma was Svayambhuva Manu,
of great might and valour, like a second Brahma.

তার দুই পুত্র প্রিয়ব্রত উত্তানপাদ ।
দুহে মহারাজা হৈল ব্রহ্মার প্রসাদ ॥ ৩৯ ॥

tāra dui putra priẏabrata uttānapāda |
duhe mahārājā haila brahmāra prasāda || 39 ||

tara dui putra — his two sons; priyavrata uttanapada — Priyavrata and Uttanapada; duhe maharaja haila — both became great kings; brahmara prasada — by Brahma's grace

39He had two sons, Priyavrata and Uttanapada;
both became great kings by Brahma's grace.

উত্তানপাদ মহারাজা দুই বিভা করি' ।
সুরুচি সুনীতি নামে দুই ত সুন্দরী ॥ ৪০ ॥

uttānapāda mahārājā dui bibhā kari' |
suruci sunīti nāme dui ta sundarī || 40 ||

uttanapada maharaja — Maharaja Uttanapada; dui vibha kari — married twice; suruchi suniti name — named Suruchi and Suniti; dui ta sundari — two beauties

40Maharaja Uttanapada married twice —
two beauties named Suruchi and Suniti.

উত্তমাদি সাত পুত্র সুরুচির হৈল ।
সুনীতির গর্ভে মাত্র ধ্রুবের জন্ম হৈল ॥ ৪১ ॥

uttamādi sāta putra surucira haila |
sunītira garbhe mātra dhrubera janma haila || 41 ||

uttamadi sata putra — seven sons beginning with Uttama; suruchira haila — were born to Suruchi; sunitira garbhe — from Suniti's womb; matra dhruvera janma haila — only Dhruva was born

41Suruchi had seven sons, beginning with Uttama;
from Suniti's womb only Dhruva was born.11

স্বামীতে সৌভাগ্য হৈল উত্তমের মাতা ।
ধ্রুবের জননী হৈল স্বামীতে দুর্ভাগা ॥ ৪২ ॥

sbāmīte saubhāgya haila uttamera mātā |
dhrubera jananī haila sbāmīte durbhāgā || 42 ||

svamite saubhagya haila — won her husband's favour; uttamera mata — Uttama's mother; dhruvera janani — Dhruva's mother; haila svamite durbhaga — fell out of her husband's favour

42Uttama's mother won her husband's favour,
while Dhruva's mother fell out of favour with her husband.

পাটমহারাণী হৈল সুরুচি সুন্দরী ।
ধ্রুবের জননী গিয়া তার সেবা করি ॥ ৪৩ ॥

pāṭamahārāṇī haila suruci sundarī |
dhrubera jananī giẏā tāra sebā kari || 43 ||

pata-maharani haila — became chief queen; suruchi sundari — the beautiful Suruchi; dhruvera janani giya — Dhruva's mother went; tara seva kari — to wait on her

43The beautiful Suruchi became the chief queen,
and Dhruva's mother went to wait on her.

ধ্রুবের মায়ের দুঃখ কহনে না যায় ।
সে দুঃখে পাথর ভাসে, সমুদ্র শুখায় ॥ ৪৪ ॥

dhrubera māẏera duḥkha kahane nā yāẏa |
se duḥkhe pāthara bhāse, samudra śukhāẏa || 44 ||

dhruvera mayera duhkha — the grief of Dhruva's mother; kahane na yaya — cannot be told; se duhkhe — at that grief; pathara bhase — stones float; samudra shukhaya — the ocean dries up

44The grief of Dhruva's mother cannot be told:
at such grief stones float and the ocean dries up.

আকাড়া-চাউলের অন্ন আলোণা ব্যঞ্জন ।
ধ্রুবের মায়েরে দেয় করিতে ভোজন ॥ ৪৫ ॥

ākāṛā-cāulera anna āloṇā byañjana |
dhrubera māẏere deẏa karite bhojana || 45 ||

akada-chaulera anna — rice of coarse grain; alona vyanjana — unsalted vegetables; dhruvera mayere deya — they gave Dhruva's mother; karite bhojana — to eat

45Rice of coarse grain and unsalted vegetables —
that is what they gave Dhruva's mother to eat.

পাঁচ বৎসর যখন ধ্রুবের বয়স ।
দুঃখী হঞা ধ্রুবের মাতা পায় নানা ক্লেশ ॥ ৪৬ ॥

pāṁca batsara yakhana dhrubera baẏasa |
duḥkhī hañā dhrubera mātā pāẏa nānā kleśa || 46 ||

pancha vatsara yakhana — when five years; dhruvera bayasa — was Dhruva's age; duhkhi haña — unhappy; dhruvera mata paya nana klesha — Dhruva's mother suffered many hardships

46When Dhruva was five years old,
Dhruva's unhappy mother suffered all kinds of hardship.

একদিন সুরুচি-সহিত মহারাজ ।
নানারসে আছে উচ্চ সিংহাসন-মাঝ ॥ ৪৭ ॥

ekadina suruci-sahita mahārāja |
nānārase āche ucca siṃhāsana-mājha || 47 ||

ekadina — one day; suruchi-sahita maharaja — the Maharaja with Suruchi; nana-rase — in pleasure; achhe uchcha simhasana-majha — sat on a high throne

47One day the Maharaja with Suruchi
sat in pleasure on a high throne.

উত্তমাদি সাত ভাই মা-বাপের সঙ্গে ।
রত্নময়-সিংহাসনে আছে নানারঙ্গে ॥ ৪৮ ॥

uttamādi sāta bhāi mā-bāpera saṅge |
ratnamaẏa-siṃhāsane āche nānāraṅge || 48 ||

uttamadi sata bhai — the seven brothers beginning with Uttama; ma-bapera sange — with their mother and father; ratna-maya-simhasane — on the jewelled throne; achhe nana-range — enjoy all kinds of amusements

48The seven brothers, beginning with Uttama, with their father and mother,
were on the jewelled throne, enjoying all kinds of amusements.

পাঁচ-বৎসরের ধ্রুব শিশুগণ-সঙ্গে ।
ধূলায় ধূসর খেলা খেলায় নানারঙ্গে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

pāṁca-batsarera dhruba śiśugaṇa-saṅge |
dhūlāẏa dhūsara khelā khelāẏa nānāraṅge || 49 ||

pancha-vatsarera dhruva — five-year-old Dhruva; shishu-gana-sange — with other children; dhulaya dhusara — grey with dust; khela khelaya nana-range — plays all kinds of games

49Five-year-old Dhruva with other children,
grey with dust, was playing all kinds of games.

বাপের কোলে দেখিল ভাই সাতজনে ।
তা দেখিয়া উঠে ধ্রুব রত্নসিংহাসনে ॥ ৫০ ॥

bāpera kole dekhila bhāi sātajane |
tā dekhiẏā uṭhe dhruba ratnasiṃhāsane || 50 ||

bapera kole dekhila — he saw on his father's lap; bhai satajane — his seven brothers; ta dekhiya — seeing that; uthe dhruva ratna-simhasane — Dhruva climbs onto the jewelled throne

50Seeing his seven brothers on his father's lap,
Dhruva climbs up onto the jewelled throne.

সিংহাসনে উঠিয়া বাপের কোলে যাইতে ।
ধ্রুবের সতাই ঠেলি' পেলিলেন ভূমিতে ॥ ৫১ ॥

siṃhāsane uṭhiẏā bāpera kole yāite |
dhrubera satāi ṭheli' pelilena bhūmite || 51 ||

simhasane uthiya — climbing onto the throne; bapera kole yaite — to get onto his father's lap; dhruvera satai — Dhruva's stepmother; theli pelilena bhumite — pushed him to the ground

51As he climbed onto the throne to get onto his father's lap,
Dhruva's stepmother pushed him down to the ground.

ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ধ্রুব কান্দিতে লাগিল ।
স্ত্রীর বশ হঞা রাজা কিছু না বলিল ॥ ৫২ ॥

bhūmite paṛiẏā dhruba kāndite lāgila |
strīra baśa hañā rājā kichu nā balila || 52 ||

bhumite padiya — fallen on the ground; dhruva kandite lagila — Dhruva began to cry; strira basha haña — in his wife's power; raja kichhu na balila — the king said nothing

52Fallen on the ground, Dhruva began to cry;
the king, in his wife's power, said nothing.

ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ধ্রুব কান্দে অভিমানে ।
মা দুর্ভাগা বাপের, ইহা নাহি জানে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

bhūmite paṛiẏā dhruba kānde abhimāne |
mā durbhāgā bāpera, ihā nāhi jāne || 53 ||

bhumite padiya — fallen on the ground; dhruva kande abhimane — Dhruva weeps in wounded pride; ma durbhaga bapera — his mother is out of his father's favour; iha nahi jane — this he does not know

53Fallen on the ground, Dhruva weeps in wounded pride:
he does not know that his mother is out of favour with his father.

ধ্রুবের সতাই বোলে—কান্দ অকারণে ।
দাসীর পুত্র হঞা উঠ রত্নসিংহাসনে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

dhrubera satāi bole—kānda akāraṇe |
dāsīra putra hañā uṭha ratnasiṃhāsane || 54 ||

dhruvera satai bole — Dhruva's stepmother says; kanda akarane — you cry for nothing; dasira putra haña — being a maidservant's son; utha ratna-simhasane — you climb onto the jewelled throne

54Dhruva's stepmother says: "You cry for nothing:
the son of a maidservant — and you climb onto the jewelled throne!

জন্মে জন্মে তোমার মা কৃষ্ণ নাহি ভজে ।
রত্নময়-সিংহাসনে উঠ কোন্ লাজে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

janme janme tomāra mā kṛṣṇa nāhi bhaje |
ratnamaẏa-siṃhāsane uṭha kon lāje || 55 ||

janme janme — birth after birth; tomara ma krishna nahi bhaje — your mother has not served Krishna; ratna-maya-simhasane — onto the jewelled throne; utha kon laje — with what shame do you climb

55Birth after birth your mother has not served Krishna —
have you no shame, climbing onto the jewelled throne?

অভাগীর পুত্র, তোর মা অবৈষ্ণবী ।
রত্নসিংহাসনে কোথা বসিবারে পাবি ॥ ৫৬ ॥

abhāgīra putra, tora mā abaiṣṇabī |
ratnasiṃhāsane kothā basibāre pābi || 56 ||

abhagira putra — son of an unfortunate woman; tora ma avaishnavi — your mother is no Vaishnavi; ratna-simhasane — on the jewelled throne; kotha vasibare pabi — where will you get to sit

56Son of an unfortunate woman, your mother is no Vaishnavi:
where will you ever sit on a jewelled throne?"

এতেক কহিল যদি ধ্রুবের সতাই ।
কান্দিতে কান্দিতে ধ্রুব গেল মায়ের ঠাঞি ॥ ৫৭ ॥

eteka kahila yadi dhrubera satāi |
kāndite kāndite dhruba gela māẏera ṭhāñi || 57 ||

eteka kahila yadi — when she had said this; dhruvera satai — Dhruva's stepmother; kandite kandite — weeping and weeping; dhruva gela mayera thani — Dhruva went to his mother

57When Dhruva's stepmother had said this,
Dhruva went weeping to his mother.

মায়েরে কহিল—মোরে সতাই মারিল ।
সিংহাসন হৈতে মোরে ঠেলিয়া পেলিল ॥ ৫৮ ॥

māẏere kahila—more satāi mārila |
siṃhāsana haite more ṭheliẏā pelila || 58 ||

mayere kahila — he told his mother; more satai marila — stepmother hit me; simhasana haite — from the throne; more theliya pelila — she pushed me down

58He told his mother: "Stepmother hit me,
she pushed me off the throne.

সতাই বোলে—তোর মা কৃষ্ণ নাহি ভজে ।
রত্নময়-সিংহাসনে বৈস কোন্ লাজে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

satāi bole—tora mā kṛṣṇa nāhi bhaje |
ratnamaẏa-siṃhāsane baisa kon lāje || 59 ||

satai bole — stepmother says; tora ma krishna nahi bhaje — your mother does not serve Krishna; ratna-maya-simhasane — on the jewelled throne; vaisa kon laje — with what shame do you sit

59Stepmother says: 'Your mother does not serve Krishna —
are you not ashamed to sit on the jewelled throne?'

আর এক অদ্ভুত অভিপ্রায় বাসি ।
এতকাল নাহি জানি—তুমি তার দাসী ॥ ৬০ ॥

āra eka adbhuta abhiprāẏa bāsi |
etakāla nāhi jāni—tumi tāra dāsī || 60 ||

ara eka adbhuta abhipraya — and one more strange thing; basi — I heard; etakala nahi jani — all this time I did not know; tumi tara dasi — that you are her maidservant

60And I have heard one more strange thing:
all this time I did not know that you are her maidservant."

এ বোল শুনিয়া কান্দে ধ্রুবের জননী ।
কৃষ্ণ নাহি ভজি বাপু, মুঞি অভাগিনী ॥ ৬১ ॥

e bola śuniẏā kānde dhrubera jananī |
kṛṣṇa nāhi bhaji bāpu, muñi abhāginī || 61 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; kande dhruvera janani — Dhruva's mother weeps; krishna nahi bhaji bapu — I did not serve Krishna, my child; munni abhagini — I am unfortunate

61Hearing this, Dhruva's mother weeps:
"I did not serve Krishna, my child — I am unfortunate.

জনমে জনমে আমি কৃষ্ণ নাহি ভাবি ।
কৃষ্ণের সেবক আমি, তাহা নাহি সেবি ॥ ৬২ ॥

janame janame āmi kṛṣṇa nāhi bhābi |
kṛṣṇera sebaka āmi, tāhā nāhi sebi || 62 ||

janame janame — birth after birth; ami krishna nahi bhavi — I did not think of Krishna; krishnera sevaka ami — I am Krishna's servant; taha nahi sevi — yet did not serve Him

62Birth after birth I never once thought of Krishna;
I am Krishna's servant, yet I did not serve Him.

না কান্দ না কান্দ বাছা দুর্ভাগীর বেটা ।
দাসীপুত্র বলিয়া সতাই দিল খোঁটা ॥ ৬৩ ॥

nā kānda nā kānda bāchā durbhāgīra beṭā |
dāsīputra baliẏā satāi dila khoṁṭā || 63 ||

na kanda na kanda — do not cry, do not cry; bachha durbhagira beta — child, son of an unfortunate woman; dasi-putra baliya — calling you a maidservant's son; satai dila khonta — your stepmother taunted you

63Do not cry, do not cry, child, son of an unfortunate woman:
your stepmother taunts you, calling you a maidservant's son."

ধ্রুবে কান্দি' মায়ে বোলে প্রবোধ-বচন ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ দাস লোচন ॥ ৬৪ ॥

dhrube kāndi' māẏe bole prabodha-bacana |
gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e dāsa locana || 64 ||

dhruve kandi — weeping, to Dhruva; maye bole prabodha-vachana — the mother speaks words of comfort; gora-guna gaya sukhe — happily sings Gora's qualities; e dasa lochana — this Lochana Dasa

64Weeping, the mother speaks words of comfort to Dhruva;
Lochana Dasa happily sings of Gora's qualities.

Raga sindhura

অভাগীর উদরে পুত্র, জন্ম হৈল তোর ধ্রুব,
কৃষ্ণসেবা নাহি করি আমি ।
বাপের দুলাল নহ, সিংহাসনে চড়িতে চাহ,
হতভাগা না জন্মিলে তুমি ॥ ৬৫ ॥

abhāgīra udare putra, janma haila tora dhruba,
kṛṣṇasebā nāhi kari āmi |
bāpera dulāla naha, siṃhāsane caṛite cāha,
hatabhāgā nā janmile tumi || 65 ||

abhagira udare — from an unfortunate woman's womb; putra janma haila tora dhruva — my son Dhruva, you were born; krishna-seva nahi kari ami — I did not serve Krishna; bapera dulala naha — you are not your father's darling; simhasane chadite chaha — you want to climb the throne; hatabhaga na janmile tumi — poor child, better you had not been born

65"From the womb of an unfortunate woman, my son Dhruva,
you were born: I did not serve Krishna.
You are not your father's darling, yet you want to climb onto the throne —
poor child, better you had not been born [to me]!

না কান্দ না কান্দ ধ্রুব, তোরে কহি অনুভব,
শুন শুন আমার বচন ।
তোমার সতাই পূর্বে, কৃষ্ণ আরাধিয়াছিল,
সৌভাগ্য হইল তে-কারণ ॥ ৬৬ ॥

nā kānda nā kānda dhruba, tore kahi anubhaba,
śuna śuna āmāra bacana |
tomāra satāi pūrbe, kṛṣṇa ārādhiẏāchila,
saubhāgya haila te-kāraṇa || 66 ||

na kanda na kanda dhruva — do not cry, Dhruva; tore kahi anubhava — I tell you what I know; shuna shuna amara vachana — listen to my words; tomara satai purve — your stepmother once; krishna aradhiyachhila — worshipped Krishna; saubhagya haila te-karana — that is why she became fortunate

66Do not cry, do not cry, Dhruva, I shall tell you what I know —
listen, listen to my words:
your stepmother once worshipped Krishna —
that is why she became fortunate.

কৃষ্ণের চরণ ভজে, সিংহাসন কিসে লাগে,
যাহা চাহ তাহা তুমি পাবে ।
মিছা অভিমান তেজ, কৃষ্ণের চরণ ভজ,
অনায়াসে সব তুমি পাবে ॥ ৬৭ ॥

kṛṣṇera caraṇa bhaje, siṃhāsana kise lāge,
yāhā cāha tāhā tumi pābe |
michā abhimāna teja, kṛṣṇera caraṇa bhaja,
anāẏāse saba tumi pābe || 67 ||

krishnera charana bhaje — if one serves Krishna's feet; simhasana kise lage — what need of a throne; yaha chaha taha tumi pabe — whatever you desire you will obtain; michha abhimana teja — give up empty pride; krishnera charana bhaja — serve Krishna's feet; anayase saba tumi pabe — you will easily obtain everything

67If you serve Krishna's feet, what need have you of the throne?
Whatever you desire, you will obtain.
Give up empty pride, serve Krishna's feet —
and you will easily obtain everything.

তুমি হেন মোর বেটা, সংসার জুড়ে খোঁটা,
কেমনে চড়িবে বাপের কোলে ।
আমি জন্ম অভাগিনী, এ বোল শুনিয়া রাণী,
ভাসিতে লাগিল অশ্রুজলে ॥ ৬৮ ॥

tumi hena mora beṭā, saṃsāra juṛe khoṁṭā,
kemane caṛibe bāpera kole |
āmi janma abhāginī, e bola śuniẏā rāṇī,
bhāsite lāgila aśrujale || 68 ||

tumi hena mora beta — such is my son; samsara jude khonta — the whole world taunts; kemane chadibe bapera kole — how will you climb onto your father's lap; ami janma abhagini — I was born unfortunate; e bola shuniya rani — saying this, the queen; bhasite lagila ashru-jale — was drowned in tears

68Such is my son — and the whole world taunts us —
how will you climb onto your father's lap?
I was born unfortunate" — saying this, the queen
was drowned in tears.

আরে ধ্রুব শুন শুন আমার বচন ।
তোর দুঃখবিমোচন, করিতে না পারে আন,
বিনে এক কমললোচন ॥ ৬৯ ॥

āre dhruba śuna śuna āmāra bacana |
tora duḥkhabimocana, karite nā pāre āna,
bine eka kamalalocana || 69 ||

are dhruva — O Dhruva; shuna shuna amara vachana — listen to my words; tora duhkha-vimochana — the relief of your grief; karite na pare ana — no one else can bring; vine eka kamala-lochana — but the one Lotus-eyed

69"O Dhruva, listen, listen to my words:
no one else can free you from your grief
but the one Lotus-eyed.

ব্রহ্মা আদি দেব যত, কৃষ্ণসেবা করি' কত,
উচ্চপদ লৈল স্বর্গভূমি ।
তুমি যদি কৃষ্ণ ভজ, সিংহাসন কোন্ পদ,
ত্রৈলোক্যপূজিত হবে তুমি ॥ ৭০ ॥

brahmā ādi deba yata, kṛṣṇasebā kari' kata,
uccapada laila sbargabhūmi |
tumi yadi kṛṣṇa bhaja, siṃhāsana kon pada,
trailokyapūjita habe tumi || 70 ||

brahma adi deva yata — Brahma and all the gods; krishna-seva kari kata — serving Krishna much; uchcha-pada laila svarga-bhumi — obtained high places in heaven; tumi yadi krishna bhaja — if you serve Krishna; simhasana kon pada — what position is a throne; trailokya-pujita habe tumi — you will be honoured in the three worlds

70Brahma and all the gods, by serving Krishna much,
obtained high places in heaven;
if you serve Krishna, what is a throne? —
you will be honoured in the three worlds."

মায়ের বচন শুনি', ধ্রুব মনে মনে গুণি',
কোথা পাব কৃষ্ণের উদ্দেশ ।
মধুবনে কৃষ্ণ পাবে, তথায়ে কেমনে যাবে,
তোরে আমি করি উপদেশ ॥ ৭১ ॥

māẏera bacana śuni', dhruba mane mane guṇi',
kothā pāba kṛṣṇera uddeśa |
madhubane kṛṣṇa pābe, tathāẏe kemane yābe,
tore āmi kari upadeśa || 71 ||

mayera vachana shuni — hearing his mother's words; dhruva mane mane guni — Dhruva ponders within; kotha paba krishnera uddesha — where shall I find Krishna; madhubane krishna pabe — you will find Krishna in Madhuvana; tathaye kemane yabe — how to go there; tore ami kari upadesha — I shall teach you

71Hearing his mother's words, Dhruva ponders within:
"Where shall I find Krishna?"
"You will find Krishna in Madhuvana; how to go there
I shall teach you.

উত্তানপাদের পুত্র, যদি হও তুমি সত্য,
সেই সিংহাসন যদি পাও ।
তবে …… ধরে, তোমাকে সৌভাগ্য করে,
সেই সিংহাসন যদি লেও ॥ ৭২ ॥

uttānapādera putra, yadi hao tumi satya,
sei siṃhāsana yadi pāo |
tabe …… dhare, tomāke saubhāgya kare,
sei siṃhāsana yadi leo || 72 ||

uttanapadera putra — the son of Uttanapada; yadi hao tumi satya — if you truly are; sei simhasana yadi pao — if you would gain that throne; tabe … dhare — then …; tomake saubhagya kare — will make you fortunate; sei simhasana yadi leo — and you will take that throne

72If you are [truly] the son of Uttanapada
and wish to obtain that throne —
then [Krishna] will make you fortunate,
and you will gain that throne."12

মায়ের চরণধূলি, শিরেতে ভূষণ করি',
শুভক্ষণে যাত্রা করি' লড়ে ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচরণ ধ্যান, মনে করি' অনুমান,
স্বর্গে জয়জয়কার পড়ে ॥ ৭৩ ॥

māẏera caraṇadhūli, śirete bhūṣaṇa kari',
śubhakṣaṇe yātrā kari' laṛe |
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇa dhyāna, mane kari' anumāna,
sbarge jaẏajaẏakāra paṛe || 73 ||

mayera charana-dhuli — the dust of his mother's feet; shirete bhushana kari — placing on his head as an ornament; shubha-kshane yatra kari lade — at an auspicious hour he sets out; shri-krishna-charana dhyana — meditation on Sri Krishna's feet; mane kari anumana — fixing in his mind; svarge jaya-jayakara pade — cries of victory ring out in heaven

73Placing the dust of his mother's feet on his head as an ornament,
at an auspicious hour he sets out,
fixing his mind on Sri Krishna's feet —
and in heaven cries of "Victory!" ring out.

Raga suhai; refrain: "Teach me — where shall I go to find news of my dark Friend?"

আর অপরূপ কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
প্রভু বোলেন—শচীমাতা করেন শ্রবণ ॥ ৭৪ ॥

āra aparūpa kathā śuna sarbajana |
prabhu bolena—śacīmātā karena śrabaṇa || 74 ||

ara aparupa katha — another wondrous story; shuna sarvajana — hear, all; prabhu bolena — the Lord tells; shachi-mata karena shravana — mother Shachi listens

74Hear, all of you, another wondrous story:
the Lord tells it, mother Shachi listens.

মায়ের চরণধূলি শিরেতে বন্দিয়া ।
মায়েরে প্রবোধ দেন কান্দিয়া কান্দিয়া ॥ ৭৫ ॥

māẏera caraṇadhūli śirete bandiẏā |
māẏere prabodha dena kāndiẏā kāndiẏā || 75 ||

mayera charana-dhuli — the dust of his mother's feet; shirete vandiya — honouring with his head; mayere prabodha dena — he consoles his mother; kandiya kandiya — weeping and weeping

75Honouring with his head the dust of his mother's feet,
weeping and weeping, he consoles his mother.

চলিলেন মধুবন ধ্রুব-মহাশয় ।
কৃষ্ণভক্তি উচ্চপদ করিঞা হৃদয় ॥ ৭৬ ॥

calilena madhubana dhruba-mahāśaẏa |
kṛṣṇabhakti uccapada kariñā hṛdaẏa || 76 ||

chalilena madhubana — set out for Madhuvana; dhruva-mahashaya — the great soul Dhruva; krishna-bhakti uchcha-pada — the high position, devotion to Krishna; kariña hridaya — setting his heart on

76The great soul Dhruva set out for Madhuvana,
having set his heart on the high position — devotion to Krishna.

পথশ্রমে ধ্রুব যদি ক্ষুধায় পীড়িত ।
মধুময় পাকা ফল পায় আচম্বিত ॥ ৭৭ ॥

pathaśrame dhruba yadi kṣudhāẏa pīṛita |
madhumaẏa pākā phala pāẏa ācambita || 77 ||

patha-shrame — weary from the road; dhruva yadi kshudhaya pidita — when Dhruva suffered from hunger; madhumaya paka phala — sweet ripe fruits; paya achambita — he suddenly found

77When Dhruva, weary from the road, suffered from hunger,
he would suddenly find sweet ripe fruits.

তৃষ্ণায় পীড়িত হঞা ধ্রুব চলি' যায় ।
সুবাসিত গন্ধজল পথমধ্যে পায় ॥ ৭৮ ॥

tṛṣṇāẏa pīṛita hañā dhruba cali' yāẏa |
subāsita gandhajala pathamadhye pāẏa || 78 ||

trishnaya pidita haña — tormented by thirst; dhruva chali yaya — Dhruva goes on; suvasita gandha-jala — fragrant water; patha-madhye paya — finds on the way

78When Dhruva went on, tormented by thirst,
he would find fragrant water on the way.

দেখি' সব দেবগণে লাগে চমৎকার ।
না জানি এই ধ্রুব কার লবে অধিকার ॥ ৭৯ ॥

dekhi' saba debagaṇe lāge camatkāra |
nā jāni ei dhruba kāra labe adhikāra || 79 ||

dekhi saba deva-gane — seeing this, all the gods; lage chamatkara — are amazed; na jani — we do not know; ei dhruva kara labe adhikara — whose place this Dhruva will take

79Seeing this, all the gods are amazed:
"We do not know whose place this Dhruva will take."13

পথে যাইতে নারদ ধ্রুবের লাগি পাইলা ।
মধুরবচনে কিছু কহিতে লাগিলা ॥ ৮০ ॥

pathe yāite nārada dhrubera lāgi pāilā |
madhurabacane kichu kahite lāgilā || 80 ||

pathe yaite — on the way; narada dhruvera lagi paila — Narada met Dhruva; madhura-vachane — with sweet words; kichhu kahite lagila — began to speak

80On the way Narada met Dhruva
and began to speak sweet words to him:

খেলার সময় তুমি রাজার নন্দন ।
মান-অভিমান চিত্তে কর অকারণ ॥ ৮১ ॥

khelāra samaẏa tumi rājāra nandana |
māna-abhimāna citte kara akāraṇa || 81 ||

khelara samaya — at the age for play; tumi rajara nandana — you, a king's son; mana-abhimana chitte — hurt and pride in your heart; kara akarana — harbour needlessly

81"At the age for play you, a king's son,
needlessly harbour hurt and pride in your heart.

এখন বনবাসে তোমারে নহে বিধি ।
বৃদ্ধকালে ভজিহ গোবিন্দ গুণনিধি ॥ ৮২ ॥

ekhana banabāse tomāre nahe bidhi |
bṛddhakāle bhajiha gobinda guṇanidhi || 82 ||

ekhana banavase — now to forest life; tomare nahe vidhi — is not the rule for you; vriddha-kale bhajiha — in old age serve; govinda guna-nidhi — Govinda, the treasury of virtues

82It is not the time for you now to go to the forest;
in old age serve Govinda, the treasury of virtues."

ধ্রুব বোলে—বৃদ্ধকালে কৃষ্ণসেবা যদি ।
যুবাকালে মরিলে কেমন তার বিধি ॥ ৮৩ ॥

dhruba bole—bṛddhakāle kṛṣṇasebā yadi |
yubākāle marile kemana tāra bidhi || 83 ||

dhruva bole — Dhruva says; vriddha-kale krishna-seva yadi — if service to Krishna is in old age; yuva-kale marile — if one dies in youth; kemana tara vidhi — what of that rule

83Dhruva answers: "If one is to serve Krishna in old age —
then if one dies in youth, what of that rule?"

ইহা শুনি' মহামুনি হরষিত হৈলা ।
দ্বাদশ-অক্ষর-মন্ত্র ধ্রুবেরে কহিলা ॥ ৮৪ ॥

ihā śuni' mahāmuni haraṣita hailā |
dbādaśa-akṣara-mantra dhrubere kahilā || 84 ||

iha shuni — hearing this; maha-muni harashita haila — the great sage rejoiced; dvadasha-akshara-mantra — the twelve-syllable mantra; dhruvere kahila — he imparted to Dhruva

84Hearing this, the great sage rejoiced
and imparted to Dhruva the twelve-syllable mantra.

পূর্বে কৃষ্ণ না ভজিঞা পাইনু এত দুখ ।
সতাইর বাক্যবাণে বিদ্ধ হৈল বুক ॥ ৮৫ ॥

pūrbe kṛṣṇa nā bhajiñā pāinu eta dukha |
satāira bākyabāṇe biddha haila buka || 85 ||

purve krishna na bhajiña — not having served Krishna before; painu eta dukha — I got so much grief; sataira vakya-bane — by the arrows of my stepmother's words; viddha haila buka — my heart is pierced

85[Dhruva said:] "Before, I did not serve Krishna — hence so much grief;
my heart is pierced by the arrows of my stepmother's words.

তুমি বড় দয়াবান্, মুঞি অভাগিয়া ।
দুঃখ দূর কর কৃষ্ণ-উপদেশ দিয়া ॥ ৮৬ ॥

tumi baṛa daẏābān, muñi abhāgiẏā |
duḥkha dūra kara kṛṣṇa-upadeśa diẏā || 86 ||

tumi bada dayavan — you are most merciful; munni abhagiya — I am unfortunate; duhkha dura kara — remove my grief; krishna-upadesha diya — by instructing me about Krishna

86You are most merciful, and I am unfortunate:
remove my grief by instructing me [in the service] of Krishna.

হেন পদ লৈব কৃষ্ণ-সেবার প্রভাবে ।
যাহা নাহি পায় মোর বাপ বড়বাপে ॥ ৮৭ ॥

hena pada laiba kṛṣṇa-sebāra prabhābe |
yāhā nāhi pāẏa mora bāpa baṛabāpe || 87 ||

hena pada laiba — such a place I shall take; krishna-sevara prabhave — by the power of serving Krishna; yaha nahi paya — as was not attained; mora bapa bada-bape — by my father and grandfather

87By the power of serving Krishna I shall gain such a place
as neither my father nor my grandfather attained."

মধুবনে যাহ ধ্রুব কালিন্দীর তীরে ।
সুস্থির আসন করি' বসি' রহ স্থিরে ॥ ৮৮ ॥

madhubane yāha dhruba kālindīra tīre |
susthira āsana kari' basi' raha sthire || 88 ||

madhubane yaha dhruva — go, Dhruva, to Madhuvana; kalindira tire — on the bank of the Kalindi; susthira asana kari — making a firm seat; vasi raha sthire — sit and remain unmoving

88[Narada said:] "Go, Dhruva, to Madhuvana, on the bank of the Kalindi;
make a firm seat, sit and remain unmoving.

বীজমন্ত্র মহা তুমি করহ সহায় ।
ওঁ নমো ভগবতে বাসুদেবায় ॥ ৮৯ ॥

bījamantra mahā tumi karaha sahāẏa |
oṁ namo bhagabate bāsudebāẏa || 89 ||

bija-mantra maha — the great seed-mantra; tumi karaha sahaya — make your support; om namo bhagavate vasudevaya — "Om, obeisance to Bhagavan Vasudeva"

89Make the great seed-mantra your support:
'Om namo bhagavate vasudevaya'.

এই মন্ত্র সদা তুমি করিহ জপ ।
সাতদিবসের মাঝে পাবে অনুভব ॥ ৯০ ॥

ei mantra sadā tumi kariha japa |
sātadibasera mājhe pābe anubhaba || 90 ||

ei mantra sada — this mantra always; tumi kariha japa — do repeat; sata-divasera majhe — within seven days; pabe anubhava — you will have realisation

90Always repeat this mantra —
and within seven days you will have realisation."

দীক্ষা-শিক্ষা পাঞা ধ্রুব হরিষ হইলা ।
প্রণাম করিয়া বৃন্দাবনেরে চলিলা ॥ ৯১ ॥

dīkṣā-śikṣā pāñā dhruba hariṣa hailā |
praṇāma kariẏā bṛndābanere calilā || 91 ||

diksha-shiksha pana — receiving initiation and instruction; dhruva harisha haila — Dhruva rejoiced; pranama kariya — bowing; vrindavanere chalila — went to Vrindavana

91Having received initiation and instruction, Dhruva rejoiced
and, bowing, went to Vrindavana.

কথোক দিবসে আসি' মধুবন পাইল ।
কল্পতরু বৃক্ষ দেখি' অবিদ্যা ছাড়িল ॥ ৯২ ॥

kathoka dibase āsi' madhubana pāila |
kalpataru bṛkṣa dekhi' abidyā chāṛila || 92 ||

kathoka divase asi — coming after some days; madhubana paila — he reached Madhuvana; kalpataru vriksha dekhi — seeing the wish-fulfilling trees; avidya chhadila — he cast off ignorance

92In some days he reached Madhuvana;
seeing the wish-fulfilling trees, he cast off ignorance.

উত্তানপাদের বেটা মধুবন পায় ।
আনন্দে লোচনদাস গোরাগুণ গায় ॥ ৯৩ ॥

uttānapādera beṭā madhubana pāẏa |
ānande locanadāsa gorāguṇa gāẏa || 93 ||

uttanapadera beta — the son of Uttanapada; madhubana paya — reaches Madhuvana; anande lochanadasa — in joy Lochana Dasa; gora-guna gaya — sings Gora's qualities

93The son of Uttanapada reaches Madhuvana —
in joy Lochana Dasa sings of Gora's qualities.

Notes

  1. The Lord speaks in the person of a man, to instruct people: He Himself is not subject to maya; "samsara" and "maya" in vv. 135–140 are the lot of conditioned souls. So Murari too understands it in v. 151.
  2. That is, the Lord, the independent Master, takes on the bhava of separation from Krishna in order to teach people and bestow His mercy on them.
  3. Cf. Murari 2.18.23: "I Myself always dwell in your shrine."
  4. The OCR of the summary is badly garbled (vv. 15–16 of the poem have also strayed into it); gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface ("the grief of mother Shachi on hearing that the Lord will take sannyasa, … the request [to keep] the [householder's] dharma; the Lord, telling the story of Dhruva, instructs in the service of Krishna; consoling His mother with various words and showing her the form of Sri Krishna, He dispels her grief"). The summary also covers pastimes told in the next portion. The disha (refrain) is given from the 1903 edition (it is illegible in the OCR of A); the 1983 edition has: "Ah, Nimai, my Nimai, do not leave me — but for you I have no one in all the world."
  5. Before Vishvarupa's birth Shachi had lost eight daughters, and Vishvarupa had taken sannyasa. In A this couplet and the beginning of the next have strayed into the OCR of the summary; restored from B and C.
  6. Shachi's arguments are the usual objections to sannyasa in youth and in the Kali age; the Lord answers them below. Shachi is the Lord's eternal mother (Yashoda in Vraja); her grief is the expression of a mother's love (vatsalya-prema).
  7. V. 34+1 (Lochana Dasa's signature) is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition has it in the main text, in brackets (as this editor marks lines found not in all manuscripts). In the 1983 edition the chapter ends with it, and the Lord's answer to His mother begins with the next chapter — with en/37, v. 180; the story of Dhruva (v. 35 — en/37, v. 179) is absent there (see note 8).
  8. The raga and refrain lines in A are badly corrupted ("যথা—রাগ । চান্দ-মুখের বচন অমিয়া । রূপ গল কেমন বিধি দৈরজ ধরিয়া ॥ ধ্রু ॥"); only the beginning is translated. In the 1903 edition these lines and the whole story of Dhruva (vv. 35–93 and beyond) are given in a footnote as an additional reading from one manuscript; the 1983 edition has no story of Dhruva: after v. 34 and the signature (v. 34+1) it goes straight on to the consolation of the mother. In Bhaktisiddhanta's edition the story is in the main text; we translate it but note that it is apparently a later insertion.
  9. The story of Dhruva is Bhagavata 4.8–9; Lochana Dasa retells it freely, with details not found in the Bhagavata.
  10. A shloka from Rupa Gosvami's Padyavali; the same as in en/24 (v. 15 of the section). Bhaktisiddhanta's prose rendering of the shloka is not translated.
  11. In the Bhagavata (4.8.8–9) Suruchi has one son, Uttama.
  12. The stanza is corrupt in A and in the 1903 edition ("তবে «'ননাম পরেশ তোমাকে মৌভাগ্য করে"; C: "তবে একবমাম ধরে? তোমাকে সৌভাগ্য করে"); translated by sense.
  13. The gods fear that the ascetic will take the place of one of them (cf. Bhagavata 4.8.80–81).
